title: Hero demo plays from the library's downloaded assets
description: Remove bundled hero MP3s from web/public/hero. Hero audio and peaks come from library stems/slices via /files/<library-relative key>, locally (apricity serve) or from the S3 bucket. Regenerate hero-data.json with library-relative paths (no absolute Ripple/samples paths). Expected: hero has no sound on a fresh clone until the fetch utility has downloaded the assets. Web/UI files belong to the web/docs session: coordinate via this issue. Depends on the purge, ae24ae.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Script scripts/hero-data.py now takes --library, builds a temp samples folder from library Clip/Slice/Marker records and writes files/hero/{brk-source,horns-source,b-track,h-track}.mp3 into the library; output byte-identical to the purged MP3s; json has library keys only. Next: web side.
